CCNL per i dipendenti da aziende del Terziario della Distribuzione e dei Servizi, Testo Unico 30 luglio 2019

notes.text: Salary tables: five tranches of the rinnovo 22/03/2024 (paga base dal 1/4/2024, 1/3/2025, 1/11/2025, 1/11/2026, 1/2/2027) taken from the official tabelle retributive as perfected by the Accordo integrativo 28/03/2024 (rounding fixes on Q, I, II, VI vs the 22/03 ipotesi), read in the signed text published by Uiltucs (pp. 63-65 of the 2024 PDF).
Seniority (Art. 205): ten triennial scatti; amounts Q 25,46, I 24,84, II 22,83, III 21,95, IV 20,66, V 20,30, VI 19,73, VII 19,47 (dal 1/1/1990, unchanged by the 2024 renewal).
'contingenza_edr' is the tables' 'Contingenza + EDR' column (contingenza frozen since November 1993 per L. 438/1992 plus EDR 10,33); 'terzo_elemento_nazionale' is the 2,07 EUR element of Art. 215.
Indennità di funzione Quadri 260,76 EUR (Art. 129, 14 mensilità; the literal sum of the increments is 260,77, the tables carry 260,76); VII livello 'altri elementi' 5,16 EUR.

Apprenticeship (Art. 53 TU 2019, unchanged in 2024): sottoinquadramento, two levels below the destination for the first half and one level below for the second half; eligible destinations II-VI (Art. 62); durations II-V 36 months, VI 24 months (Art. 64). Track 'livelli_2_5' (18+18 months), track 'livello_6' (VII for the first 12 months; the second half stays at VII by the general one-level-below rule, lexplain.it reads it as VI: adopted the literal text). The Art. 68 Tabella B profiles (PDF pp. 82-83) are tracks 'tabella_b_48_mesi' (levels 2 and 3, 24+24 months) and 'tabella_b_42_mesi' (level 4, 21+21 months); an apprentice of levels 2, 3 and 4 states Apprentice.track ('livelli_2_5' for the 36 months). The farmacista di parafarmacia derogation (Accordo 31/10/2024) is not modelled: its text was not found.

limitation.remediation: Model the farmacista di parafarmacia apprenticeship of the Accordo 31/10/2024 once its text is found.

notes.text: INPS: see the terziario sector rules (knowledge/sector/2026/terziario.json, knowledge/contribution/2026/terziario.json) (review of 2026-10-30).
CNEL code H011 confirmed by Il Sole 24 Ore / INPS UNIEMENS reference.

TERZO ELEMENTO NAZIONALE (Art. 215): 2.07 EUR a month due only in the provinces where no provincial third element is in force; paid when EmployerProfile.provincial_pay_element is false, left out with a missing_fact blocker when it is not stated.

SICKNESS (Art. 187): the CCNL integrates up to a share of the net daily pay ('retribuzione giornaliera netta') without saying how the net pay is computed. The engine grosses up the INPS indemnity by the worker's INPS rate (the 'lordizzazione' of payroll practice, Ordine dei Consulenti del Lavoro di Salerno) and tops it up to the measure of the gross daily quota; IRPEF is left out, as it falls on both. Day bands, carenza by event, the yearly comporto and the exclusion of apprentices are modelled.

limitation.remediation: Find a source (an interpretation of the parties, an INPS or Ministry text) that defines the net daily pay of Art. 187, align the computation, then resolve this limitation.

notes.text: Art. 191 covers the patron saint holiday of art. 154 during sickness and injury when EmployerProfile.patron_saint_day is stated. Without that workplace-specific date, the local holiday cannot be determined from the national calendar.

limitation.remediation: Resolved: the art. 191 holiday top-ups count the art. 154 local patron saint day the employer states (EmployerProfile.patron_saint_day), read on 2026-11-10.

notes.text: HOURLY RATE AND SUPPLEMENTS (Testo Unico 30 July 2019, unchanged by the 2024 renewal, artt. 149-157, 206-211): without a caller value the engine derives the hourly base (the normale retribuzione of art. 206 over 168), the 15% on ordinary night hours from 22 to 6 (art. 151), the 30% on festività hours paid as straordinario festivo (art. 155 with art. 149), the 30% on ordinary Sunday hours (art. 153; 10% at the motorway fuel stations of art. 157, role impianto_carburante_autostradale: Employment.roles must be stated) and the 30% on the hours of the weekly rest day (art. 156). Art. 155 also pays the festività hours themselves: the engine posts the 30% only and the run is provisional. Second-level agreements may replace the Sunday and night rules (art. 153). Not derived: the divisors 182 and 195 of the 42- and 45-hour weeks; shift work, left to second-level bargaining.

LEAVE, WEEKLY SCHEDULE: a 39-hour full-time week absorbs 36 hours of ROL and a 38-hour week 16 hours of ex festività and 56 of ROL, read from Employment.full_time_weekly_hours. The grandi magazzini, magazzini a prezzo unico, supermercati alimentari, cash&carry and ipermercati (Art. 134, EmployerProfile.subsector 'grande_distribuzione') on a 38-hour average absorb instead the 56 hours of Art. 158 c. 3 and the 16 of c. 4 and keep the ex festività.

FIRST- AND THIRD-LEVEL APPRENTICES (Art. 69): modelled in dual_apprenticeship (first level 50/50/65/70% of the qualified worker's pay by year of the contract, third level two then one level below the destination by half of the programme; training at the employer 10%, school hours unpaid). The contributions of these apprentices are the engine limitation dual_apprenticeship_contributions.

Art. 54 b): the employer pays 60% of the gross pay on the days of a hospital stay, read as added to the INPS indemnity ('oltre a quanto previsto dalla legislazione vigente'); the text does not say whether the 60% is instead the whole treatment the employer tops the INPS share up to, which would pay 50 points of the gross daily pay less on days 4-20 (60% in all against 50% + 60%). The INPS indemnity during the stay is not reduced to 2/5 for a worker without family dependants.

limitation.remediation: Source the reading of the hospital indemnity of the apprentice (a joint interpretation of the parties or a ruling) and apply it; then resolve this limitation.

location.quote: 1) 100% (cento per cento) per primi tre giorni (periodo di carenza); 2) 75% (settantacinque per cento) per i giorni dal 4° al 20°; 3) 100% ... dal 21° in poi

provenance.transformation: Art. 187 b): 100% for the three days of carenza, 75% for days 4-20 and 100% from day 21, stored as day_bands of the episode; the carenza at 66%, 50% and 0% from the third event of the calendar year as carenza_by_event; comporto of 180 days in the calendar year (Art. 186) as max_duration_days counted over the year. The measures are of the 'retribuzione giornaliera netta' (net_basis): the INPS share, free of contributions, is grossed up by the worker's INPS rate before the company tops it up to the measure, so that the worker's pay net of contributions reaches it; the company owes apprentices no integration and no carenza (apprentices_excluded).
provenance.note: Net basis, p. 177: '100% (cento per cento) per i giorni dal 21° in poi della retribuzione giornaliera netta cui il lavoratore avrebbe avuto diritto in caso di normale svolgimento del rapporto. Per retribuzione giornaliera si intende la quota giornaliera della retribuzione di fatto di cui all'art.208.' Apprentices, p. 178: 'Le indennità a carico del datore di lavoro non sono dovute nei casi di cui ai successivi artt. 189 e 195 né agli apprendisti.' The CCNL does not say how the net pay is computed: the gross-up of the INPS indemnity by the worker's contributions ('lordizzazione') is the payroll practice described by the Ordine dei Consulenti del Lavoro di Salerno (https://www.ordineconsulentilavorosalerno.it/files/2021/06/slides_zinno.pdf, 'la somma a carico dell'INAIL dev'essere aumentata dei contributi INPS'), not a norm; the open limitation sickness_net_basis records it. Quotes read on 2026-10-10.

location.quote: Durante il periodo di malattia l’apprendista avrà diritto, oltre a quanto previsto dalla legislazione vigente: a) per i primi tre giorni di malattia, limitatamente a sei eventi morbosi in ragione d’anno, ad un’indennità pari al 60% della retribuzione lorda cui avrebbe avuto diritto in caso di normale svolgimento del rapporto; b) in caso di ricovero ospedaliero e per tutta la durata dello stesso, entro i limiti di cui all’art. 186 della disciplina contrattuale nazionale del Terziario, ad un’indennità a carico del datore di lavoro, pari al 60% della retribuzione lorda cui avrebbe avuto diritto in caso di normale svolgimento del rapporto. Le disposizioni di cui alle lettere a) e b) si applicano a decorrere dal superamento del periodo di prova.

provenance.transformation: The apprentice sickness rules replace the general ones for an apprentice. a) The three days of carenza paid at 60% of the gross daily pay for the first six events of the calendar year ('in ragione d'anno' read as the calendar year, the year of the comporto), none from the seventh: carenza_integration_rate 0.6 with carenza_by_event from the 7th event at 0, every event counted (the exemptions of the general sickness article do not apply to this clause). b) On each day of a hospital stay within the comporto the employer pays 60% of the gross daily pay: on top of the INPS share of an indemnified day ('oltre a quanto previsto dalla legislazione vigente'), and 60% on a waiting day whatever the event (hospital_employer_share 0.6). No other integration (full_pay_integration_rate 0), gross basis, comporto of 180 days in the calendar year of art. 186. Both from the end of the probation (after_probation). Holidays in the sickness are not topped up for an apprentice: the general holiday clause is read as part of the treatment apprentices are excluded from.

reviews.scope: Whole file. The values checked were not recorded; no value was marked verified.

reviews.scope: Every payable rule of the file (80 records) read again in the signed texts: the Testo Unico of 30 July 2019 and the renewal of 22 March 2024 with the accordo integrativo of 28 March 2024.
findings: 64 records match their source and are verified; no amount differs. Pages are PDF page indexes (the printed page of the 2019 text is one higher).
Wrong page citations corrected: Artt. 210-211 on p. 197, Art. 159 on p. 157, Artt. 186-187 on pp. 178-180.
The 16 contingenza and terzo elemento records match in amount, but no source states their valid_from 1993-11-01: they stay derived. No effect on periods from 2024-04-01.
The Fon.Te. rates are read in Art. 107 (and Art. 57 for apprentices) of the 2019 text instead of the fund's information sheet.
Not modelled: the two one-off payments of the 2024 renewal (level IV 175 EUR on 1 July 2024 and on 1 July 2025, 2024 text p. 50).
Pages 1-62 of the 2024 text are image-only and were read by OCR; the expiry clause of Art. 259 is illegible.

reviews.scope: P1 audit: the 16 contingenza and terzo elemento records left derived on 2026-10-11, and the tranche tables of pp. 64-65 of the 2024 renewal.
findings: The six tranche tables (1/4/2023 to 1/2/2027) print the paga base, 'Altri el.' and 'Contingenza + EDR' of the bundle for every level, with the same dates.

The renewal of 22 March 2024 (pp. 1-62 read by OCR) does not cite Art. 215.

reviews.scope: The basis of the indemnity for the leave not taken at the end of the employment (work_rules.leave_rules.termination) read again in the cited text.
findings: Art. 159 - Chiarimento a verbale (p. 157): the indemnity of the ferie at the end of the employment is the retribuzione mensile di fatto divided by twenty-six, as recorded; the basis is now verified.

reviews.scope: The indennità di cassa e maneggio denaro of Art. 218 (p. 200), checked by a separate session from the PDF.
findings: Art. 218 (PDF p. 200, sha256 76420e3a... matched): 5% of the paga base nazionale conglobata of Art. 212, to the staff normally at the till with full responsibility for it and bound to make good its shortfalls: levels[*].fixed_allowances[IND_CASSA], role cassiere.

Art. 206 (p. 195) and Art. 212 (pp. 197-198): the paga base is item a), apart from the contingenza and the terzi elementi; base_salary holds the first column of each quoted row only. 40 values out of 40 recomputed, no difference (round half up; level 2 from 2027-02-01, 90.125, is 90.13).
Artt. 208, 220, 221 (pp. 196, 200-201) and Art. 249 (pp. 216-217): no exclusion reaches the allowance, so it is in the retribuzione di fatto, the 13th, the 14th and the TFR.
The renewal of 2024 (Ccnl_Tds_Confcommercio_2023-2027_e_accordo_integrativo.pdf) is a scan without a text layer: it was not searched for a change to Art. 218.

reviews.scope: The hourly divisors of the 42 and 45 hour weeks, Art. 211 (p. 197), checked by a separate session from the PDF.
findings: Art. 211 (PDF p. 197, sha256 76420e3a... matched): 168 for a normal week of 40 hours, 182 for 42, 195 for 45, for the quota oraria 'sia normale che di fatto': work_rules.time_supplements.hourly_divisor_weekly_hours 40 and week_divisors 42/182, 45/195.

Art. 89 (p. 95): a part-time worker takes the divisor of Art. 211 of the full-time week, so the divisor is chosen by Employment.full_time_weekly_hours. Artt. 130 c. 2 and 147 set the 45-hour normal week of fuel-station and discontinuous workers; Art. 134 keeps the normal week at 40 (state 40, not 38).
The renewal of 2024 has a text layer only on its last four pages (accordo integrativo 28 March 2024, no change to Art. 211); the scanned body was not searched.

Ambiguous in the text, kept as read: the base of the 10% training share ('di quella che gli sarebbe dovuta').

findings: Confirmed: a net-basis 100% target alone pays 64.82 where the gross holiday pay of art. 191 is 68.52; this finding preceded the separate gross-basis target.

Confirmed: holidays of a year-crossing absence are classified by their own year.

Confirmed: 60% carenza for six events a year, 60% of the gross pay on hospital-stay days, nothing in the probation, gross basis, 180 days in the calendar year; hand amounts of the Commercio test case recomputed.

Lgs. n. 81/2015 per le ore di formazione svolte nella istituzione formativa e per le ore di formazione svolte presso il datore di lavoro contenute nel piano curriculare, la retribuzione per le ore svolte presso il datore di lavoro, eccedenti a quelle contenute nel predetto piano di formazione, è stabilita in misura percentuale rispetto a quella corrisposta ai lavoratori qualificati secondo le seguenti misure: primo e secondo anno: 50%; terzo anno: 65%; eventuale quarto anno: 70%

provenance.transformation: Work hours: by year of the apprenticeship contract, 50% (months 0-23), 65% (24-35), 70% (36 on) of the whole pay of the destination level (the qualified worker); training at the employer 10% of the same pay (agreement of 2016, p. 399: 'Avendo a riferimento la retribuzione del lavoratore qualificato per la medesima figura professionale'), school hours unpaid. 'anno' is read as the year of the contract.
